# cubejs 1.3.2

`index.js`, `lib/cube.js`, `lib/solve.js`, and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged from the npm release cubejs@1.3.2 by akheron / ldez, https://github.com/ldez/cubejs (MIT license).

The local package manifest excludes the upstream package's `npm@6` dependency. That dependency is not imported by either runtime file, is not needed for modeling or solving, and introduced obsolete tooling with security advisories. The solver implementation is unmodified.
